ModMetaData.name: Main Button Bar System
ModMetaData.author: NAI
ModMetaData.description:
Customise the bottom main button bar: reorder by dragging, hide, rename, set widths, pin to either end, and collapse rarely used buttons into a "More" drawer or let the bar scroll. Per-save settings with a default template, hotkeys for every button, custom and imported icons, themes, export/import of arrangements, 29 languages.
Nothing changes until you change something: a fresh install looks exactly like the game.
Works with mods that add icons, windows or buttons. Mods that take over the whole bar (TooManyButtons, Custom Bottom Bar, UI Not Included, DragReorder) are detected; you choose who draws it.
Settings: Options > Mod settings > Main Button Bar System, or the gear in the "More" drawer. For modders: API.md in the mod folder.
